itens.trecho: Rick and Morty is one of the only TV Shows in the history of TV which was made for smart-ass Dumb Science Loving Book-worms but ended up as a mainstream Fan Gatherer. It's pretty great how a show like this accomplished such greatness among the other Dumb hits.

It has that cheap as heck animation that I hate. The "I'm 12, put this on the fridge, mommy" sort of quality animation And I absolutely hate that. Basically, any show with animation worse than Family Guy has to work really hard just to win me over a little. But, it turned out to be the most darkly sarcastic show that I've seen on television. Ever.
